name: Daraku shita Rikka
source: Hibiki and Gridman suffer severe injuries after being defeated in battle. To stop Akane from continuing to send monsters to destroy the city, Rika is blackmailed and willingly becomes Akane's sex slave...
translation: 响和格里德曼在战斗中被击败后受了重伤。为了阻止茜继续派遣怪物毁灭城市，莉卡受到勒索，甘愿成为茜的性奴隶……
